context: Hiroshi gives Ren an intern progress review.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: レン君、最初の段階、終わったな。
lines.style: Brief nod of acknowledgment. Composed, measured. Light pause after the name. Not quite approving yet—observing. The tone of someone who tracks progress without sentimentality.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、何とか、終えました。
lines.en: Yes—somehow I managed to finish it.
lines.style: Careful, slightly self-deprecating. Breathes into the pause. Respectful without being stiff. A hint of relief underneath—he made it through, but he's checking Hiroshi's face to see if it's enough.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 評価、悪くない。次、期待してる。
lines.en: The results aren't bad. I'm looking forward to what's next.
lines.style: Deliberate, almost pointed. The word 「悪くない」lands with light weight—not lavish praise, but genuine. Steady eye-level. A quiet signal of real confidence in him.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: ありがとうございます。
lines.style: Soft, formal, genuine gratitude. No flourish. Meets the compliment without deflecting. The voice of someone steadied by being seen.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.en: Trust your own strength. That's where success comes from.
lines.style: Slower, more deliberate than before. Each phrase lands separately. Not lecturing—offering. The tone shifts slightly warmer, more personal. A statement that carries weight because he means it.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.en: I'll do my best—with your support.
lines.style: Quiet determination. Soft but steady. A slight lean into the commitment. Not nervous—resolved. The word 「一緒に」carries the real meaning: I'm not doing this alone.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.style: Brief, matter-of-fact closing. A small shift toward action—already thinking ahead. Warm enough to include the information casually, but the sentence moves forward. Final.
